Plot a Pacific-centred base map

plot_pacific.Rd

Draws the world coastline using the Pacific-centred "world2" map from the maps package, optionally overlaid with Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) boundaries.

Usage

plot_pacific(
  xlim = c(100, 292),
  ylim = c(-62, 60),
  land_fill = mapping_colours("land"),
  land_outline = mapping_colours("land_outline"),
  water_fill = mapping_colours("water"),
  base_size = 15,
  show_eez = FALSE,
  eez_flag = NULL,
  eez_colour = "blue"
)

Arguments

xlim

Numeric vector of length 2. Longitude limits in degrees east, on a 0-360 scale (e.g. 180 is the antimeridian and 200 is 160°W). Defaults to c(100, 292). If NULL, the default is used.

ylim

Numeric vector of length 2. Latitude limits in degrees, with negative values south of the equator. Defaults to c(-62, 60). If NULL, the default is used.

land_fill

Fill colour for land polygons. Defaults to mapping_colours("land").

land_outline

Outline colour for land polygons. Defaults to mapping_colours("land_outline").

water_fill

Background colour for the panel, representing water. Defaults to mapping_colours("water").

base_size

Base font size in points, passed to ggplot2::theme_minimal(). Defaults to 15.

show_eez

Logical. If TRUE, EEZ boundaries are drawn beneath the land layer. Defaults to FALSE.

eez_flag

Character vector of flag codes used to select which EEZs are drawn when show_eez = TRUE. If NULL (default), no flag filter is applied. Ignored when show_eez = FALSE.

eez_colour

Colour of the EEZ boundary lines. Defaults to "blue". Ignored when show_eez = FALSE.

Value

A ggplot object.
